subject.title: fix(agents): prevent recursive task execution during model fallback

question: Should this PR land as a scoped embedded `sessions_spawn` mitigation while the broader fallback completion-announcement issue remains open, or should it wait for one shared work-spawning policy seam?
rationale: The patch changes fallback-turn delegation policy and intentionally leaves related OpenClaw and Codex delegation surfaces uncovered, so automation cannot choose the product boundary or cross-repo ownership.

options.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation After Rebase
options.body: Rebase the branch, merge the embedded `sessions_spawn` guard, and keep the canonical issue open for gateway, sessions_send/cron, and Codex-native follow-ups.

options.title: Harden More Before Merge
options.body: Require the PR to add a shared completion-event instruction or policy path for more OpenClaw delegation surfaces before landing.

options.title: Pause For Common Seam
options.body: Hold or close this branch until maintainers choose a single work-spawning policy seam that can cover OpenClaw tools and Codex-native delegation consistently.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation After Rebase
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, merge the embedded `sessions_spawn` guard, and keep the canonical issue open for gateway, sessions_send/cron, and Codex-native follow-ups.
